arStrings.szText: This Mega Bundle includes "The Lord Eater" Barbarian equipment, "The Pitiless Executioner" Necromancer equipment, "Hunger of the Dethroner" Druid equipment, "The Grinning Priestess" Sorcerer equipment, "The Red Devil's Revolution" Paladin equipment, "The Hungry Devil" Rogue equipment, "The Flesh Dancer" Spiritborn equipment, "Onibi's Vitriol" Warlock equipment, and "Demon of the Angry Sky" mount and mount armor.
